scenario: A buyer needs to hand a phone to their mother for calls, photos, and messaging over the next few years. A frozen seller page shows one TCL A30 configuration at a low price with a favorable-looking current aggregate, while one forum author says their unnamed low-budget phones became poor after a year or two and a different author reports a battery-health change on an iPhone XR after thirteen months. A general smartphone reference describes battery wear as a possible path to lower capacity and output power. The material does not contain a six-month or multi-year record for the listed TCL A30 configuration, an update-support commitment for that exact configuration, a matched longitudinal cohort behind the seller aggregate, or a task-based trial by the buyer's mother. The research problem is therefore to audit whether the evidence units can be joined, state what remains unknown, and design a reversible handoff or defer decision without inventing a durability winner.

rules.exact_listing_snapshot_scope_v1: The frozen seller page shows the TCL A30 listing as in stock with SKU B09B79YT3S, Rating: 87 % of 100, 12 Reviews, and a price of 109.99 dollars. Its title identifies a 5.5-inch HD+ display, an 8 MP rear camera, 32 GB storage plus 3 GB RAM, a 3000 mAh battery, Android 11, and Prime Black. Preserve the rating exactly in the displayed 87-percent-of-100 form because the page does not define a star conversion. These are listing-level identity, configuration, price, and current aggregate observations. They are not a same-cohort follow-up, an independent test, an update-support promise, or evidence that calls, photos, messaging, storage headroom, battery life, or responsiveness will remain acceptable for years.
rules.scoped_time_reports_and_transfer_limits_: One forum author says only that the author's unnamed low-budget phones became poor after a year or two before buying an iPhone 14 Pro. The post names neither those earlier models nor their configurations, workloads, failure modes, update state, battery condition, or usability thresholds. A different author says an iPhone XR bought new had 89-percent reported battery health after thirteen months and describes that author's charging pattern. That report is about one person and one different exact model; it is not a TCL A30 comparison and does not measure calls, photos, messaging, application speed, or a population rate. Keep both time reports scoped to their authors and devices.
rules.general_battery_path_not_model_predictio: The smartphone reference says smartphones commonly use lithium-ion or lithium-polymer batteries and that repeated charging and discharging chemically wears batteries, reducing energy capacity and output power; it describes possible downstream loss of processing speed and eventual outages. This supplies a general possible path, not the starting condition, rate, timing, severity, or inevitability for the listed TCL A30, the forum author's unnamed phones, the iPhone XR, or the buyer's mother. It cannot prove a six-month cliff, and it supplies no exact update policy, storage-headroom threshold, or application-growth forecast.
rules.same_model_longitudinal_match_audit_v1: The seller snapshot and the two community time reports cannot be joined into one longitudinal claim. The seller page concerns an exact TCL A30 configuration at one capture time but contains no later outcome. The low-budget report contains a one-to-two-year outcome but no model or configuration. The iPhone XR report contains a different exact model and a thirteen-month battery-health observation but no TCL comparison or task-based usability result. Therefore the material cannot identify whether the favorable-looking aggregate and the negative folklore describe the same model, owners, cohort, time horizon, or outcome definition. The correct result of the match audit is unresolved, not a weighted vote between unrelated evidence units.
rules.mechanism_bounded_handoff_trial_v1: Use the battery mechanism to decide what to observe, not what outcome to predict. Before handoff, separately verify the exact sold variant, carrier compatibility, return period, and a current update and security-support policy for that exact model from a source not present in this corpus. During a returnable trial, use the mother's actual SIM, contacts, messaging applications, photo workflow, accessibility settings, and ordinary network conditions. Predeclare pass conditions for successful calls, prompt message delivery and app opening, acceptable photo capture and sharing, enough free storage after migration and updates, and battery endurance for her normal day. Record baseline storage and battery behavior, retest after migration and updates, and do not infer a future cliff from 32 GB, 3 GB RAM, Android 11, or 3000 mAh alone.
rules.backup_maintenance_and_defer_protocol_v1: Back up contacts and photos before handoff, retain a recovery path for account access, and schedule simple checks for security-update status, free storage, battery behavior, call reliability, messaging delivery, camera launch, and required-app compatibility. Define action triggers in advance: a missed critical task that persists after ordinary troubleshooting, inability to install required security or application updates, storage that cannot retain the agreed free-space reserve after cleanup, or battery behavior that no longer covers the mother's normal day prompts maintenance, battery service where available, replacement, or restoration from backup. These are operational safeguards and user-defined thresholds, not claims that the corpus predicts when a trigger will occur.
rules.evidence_bounded_mother_phone_decision_v: The corpus does not support handing over or rejecting the TCL A30 on a multi-year reliability claim. A conditional handoff is admissible only if the exact variant and carrier fit are verified, current update-support information is obtained, return terms permit a realistic task trial, and the exact phone passes the mother's calls, photos, messaging, accessibility, storage, battery, and required-app checks. Keep backups and maintenance triggers active after handoff. If update support, returnability, or critical-task performance remains unknown or fails, defer or compare another exact returnable configuration under the same protocol. Do not force a winner from brand, price, the 87-percent seller aggregate, another person's unnamed phones, an iPhone XR anecdote, or a general battery mechanism.
